content.title: Aerospace & Manufacturing Customer References
content.content:
SnapLogic has production deployments in aerospace supply chains, regulated manufacturing, and defence-adjacent environments. Table~\ref{tab:customer-refs} summarizes confirmed customers available as references for Airbus Helicopters:

[TABLE:accent-blue:Aerospace & Manufacturing References::customer-refs]
| Account | Sector | Use Case Summary | Deployment |
|---------|--------|------------------|------------|
| **Schneider Electric** | Industrial Manufacturing / Energy | Schneider Electric deployed SnapLogic to integrate manufacturing execution systems, IoT/OT data streams, and enterprise ERP across a multi-site industrial environment. The implementation succeeded factory floor sensor data aggregation, real-time asset monitoring and supply chain visibility, replacing a fragmented landscape of custom scripts and point-to-point integrations. Strict data sovereignty requirements for French production sites. | Hybrid (Ground Plex + Cloud) |
| **Boehringer Ingelheim** | Biopharma / Regulated / Life Sciences | Boehringer Ingelheim operates SnapLogic's Ground Plex on RedHat OpenShift within a DoP-regulated manufacturing environment — the deployment model directly comparable to Airbus Helicopters' planned Groundplex infrastructure. The migration spans laboratory systems, manufacturing execution, and ERP, with full audit trail and data lineage required for regulatory compliance. The OpenShift deployment passed internal security review under strict data residency and validation requirements. | On-Premises (OpenShift) |
| **Siemens / Siemens Healthineers** | Industrial Manufacturing / Medtech | Siemens and Siemens Healthineers run enterprise-scale SnapLogic deployments spanning SAP, PLM systems, and operational excellence across multiple business units. The implementation includes a citizen developer programme enabled by SnapGPT, allowing domain teams to build and extend integrations without central IT dependency. The deployment demonstrates SnapLogic's ability to operate across complex, multi-entity manufacturing and healthcare environments. | Hybrid |
[/TABLE]

As demonstrated in Table~\ref{tab:customer-refs}, SnapLogic has proven experience across aerospace, manufacturing, and regulated environments. Additional references in aerospace supply chain and defence-adjacent sectors are available upon request. Reference contacts and direct availability for evaluation committee conversations can be arranged through the SnapLogic account team.
